description: Demolition of existing carwash facility and the erection of a terrace of 5 two storey 3 bedroom townhouses  and 1 single storey 1 bed townhouse with associated parking.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, Planning Statement, Structural Engineers Report,  Design and Access Statement, Code for Sustainable Drawing Numbers PA121, PA122, PA123, PA124, PA130, PA131, PA132, PA133, PA134, PA135, PA140, PA141, PA151, topographical survey, 7644/009, 7644/010, 7644/011, 7644/012, PA100, PA120, Declaration of CIL liability, received 02/08/12) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except
between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to
1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public
holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority in
writing.

Condition : 4 - "Before the development hereby permitted commences:
a.	A contaminated land Phase 1 desk study report shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Should the Phase 1 report recommend that a Phase 2 site investigation is required, then this shall be carried out and submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.  Additional investigation may be required where it is deemed necessary.
b.	If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval.  The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied.
   During the course of the development:
c.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
   Before the development is first brought into use:
d.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is occupied arrangements shall be agreed in writing with the local planning authority and be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the area at any time.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted, including those on the projecting bays, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 7 - The development hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of refuse or waste recycling have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing of refuse or waste recycling shall not be
carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 8 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. This shall take the form of a noise survey which identifies noise exposure categories, suitable design measures and shows the provision of acceptable internal noise levels. Any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed, a completion certificate submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority,  before any part of the development is first occupied or used. These works shall be in accordance with the good category specified in BS 8233.

Condition : 10 - Construction shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the basement recreational area, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - The applicant must submit (a) an air quality screening assessment, using appropriate tools such as ADMS or others, using significance criteria specified in the Great London Council's Guidance and submit a report to quantify the impact of the development on air quality in the surrounding area and (b) Submit a report that incorporates suitable mitigation measures, which provide clean, healthy habitable environment inside the dwellings.

Condition : 12 - The dwellings shall achieve Level 3, or higher, of the Code for Sustainable Homes. No dwelling shall be occupied until a final post-construction code certificate has been issued, and submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 14 - Pedestrian visibility splays of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be on either side of each crossover with nothing over 600mm high in this region.

Condition : 15 - A construction management and logistics plan shall be submitted to the local authority and TfL prior to the commencement of the development. Vehicles movements shall be limited to off-peak times only (outside 7-10am and 4-7pm).
